articles.title: BP Reduces Stake in Norwegian Producer
articles.summary: BP sold a five percent stake in Aker BP for around $1.06 billion, part of the British company's efforts to free up cash.

articles.title: BP shares fall after $1.06 bln Aker BP stake sale
articles.summary: Investing.com -- BP shares fell as much as 2.2% on Thursday before paring losses to trade down 0.11% after the British energy company raised about $1.06 billion through the sale of a 5% stake in Norwegian oil and gas producer Aker BP.

articles.title: BP Raises $1.06 Billion From Aker BP Stake Sale
articles.summary: The British energy major has reduced its ownership in Norway's Aker BP to strengthen its balance sheet and boost annual divestment proceeds.

articles.title: BP Sells 5% Stake in Aker BP for $1 Billion as Balance Sheet Repair Continues
articles.summary: The British energy major is looking to accelerate efforts to shore up its balance sheet and simplify its portfolio.

articles.title: BP Stock Gains 40.6% in a Year: Should You Bet on the Stock Now?
articles.summary: BP stock has surged 40.6% in a year, driven by strong earnings. Portfolio restructuring, cost reductions and exploration investments strengthen its growth outlook.

articles.title: BP (LSE:BP.) Completes 65% Castrol Stake Sale
articles.summary: BP (LSE:BP.) has completed the sale of a 65% stake in its Castrol lubricants unit to infrastructure investor Stonepeak. The transaction gives BP cash proceeds that management plans to apply toward reducing the group’s outstanding debt. Castrol is set to operate as an independent business, with BP retaining a minority shareholding in the lubricants specialist.
